text:
First a trembling, vague glow,
a line of restless light cutting across the sea;
then it sparks and grows and spreads
in a burning explosion of brightness.

The gleaming light is joy;
the fearful shadow is sorrow:
alas, in the dark night of my soul,
when will dawn come?

translation.title: Rhyme LXII: First a Trembling, Vague Glow
